provider_api_note: NTW32-specific WIN64 subsystem client (win64/ntw64.h); never routed from KERNEL32 imports
evidence: Build/static/host contracts only; no Windows 98 guest result for this provider
limits: GetTickCount64 cannot recover wraps before DLL load or multiple unobserved wraps
SRW contention uses Sleep(0); no fairness guarantee
GetProcAddress only redirects implemented names for the real KERNEL32 handle through prepared calls
InitOnce has no abandoned-thread or SEH recovery; exact native error parity remains unverified
UTF conversion is independently implemented for CP_UTF8; other code pages delegate to native KERNEL32
UTF maximal-subpart replacement, strict alignment, full-range overlap rejection and error precedence have no native Windows differential proof
AddVectoredExceptionHandler order is host-tested; it is not connected to a CPU trap or the Win98 SEH chain
RemoveVectoredExceptionHandler returns 0 for an unknown handle and does not pretend success
The WIN64 subsystem API needs NTWRAP9X.VXD under the ShizukuDOS Supervisor with a Kernel64 domain; otherwise every call fails with the loader or VxD error
